verdict.summary: Round 8's delegation defect is resolved. PublicGrant now carries max_epoch as a distinct canonical field (wire key 17), includes it in signing_bytes/cap_id, decodes it fail-closed, and rejects a ceiling below the grant's exact epoch. delegate preserves the parent's exact epoch and epoch-specific topic, inherits an omitted parent ceiling, rejects widening an existing ceiling, and signs the resulting bound. The focused delegation test exercises the real encode/decode/signature path, confirms epoch/topic preservation, verifies round-trip authentication, detects max_epoch tampering, and covers both below-scope and re-delegation widening failures. The research-grade/external-audit caveats remain explicit. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction was found in the diff.
